translations.web: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.
translations.bsb: Egypt’s help is futile and empty; therefore I have called her Rahab Who Sits Still.
translations.kjv: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.
translations.asv: For Egypt helpeth in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I called her Rahab that sitteth still.
